reply.text:
Yes, lifting at 78 is worth doing, and plenty of people start later than you think. The general picture is that strength work helps with balance, getting up from a chair, carrying groceries and staying independent, and that a sensible start is light loads, few sets and good form rather than heavy weights.

Whether it's safe for you specifically depends on your health history, any conditions you have, and any medications, so please get a check-up from your doctor before you start, and tell them you plan to begin lifting. If you have a heart, joint or balance concern, a physio can also tell you what to avoid. Once they've cleared you, tell me what equipment you have and what you want to avoid, and I'll build a beginner plan around that.
